history.event: The smartphone criteria in the order of 29 December 2020 enter into force.
The EU energy label applies to newly placed-on-market smartphones and tablets. Its repairability class is a separate system, not another version of this score out of 10.
The French smartphone criteria order is repealed following publication of the order of 26 June 2025 on 6 July.
